props.caption: Turkey’s parliament has the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement before it for ratification.
A missile attack on a Shabwa military camp killed 73 recruits; 14 people remain missing.
PHP released updates for four versions to address two critical vulnerabilities.

lead.what: Turkey submitted the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement to parliament for ratification; the call is 65% for approval by 31 December.

rest.what: Shabwa authorities say 73 people were killed in the military-camp strike and 14 remain missing.

lead.what: Treasury sanctioned Karnakis and Karnakis over alleged Iranian-shipping support while FinCEN advanced a Greek bank investigation.

rest.what: PHP released fixes for two critical remote-code-execution vulnerabilities affecting web-serving installations.

lead.what: Canada and Ontario announced a C$8.7bn tariff-response package for steel, automotive projects and road infrastructure.
